Gold, crypto, the debt crisis, and survival when America needs a bailout fill this Tucker Carlson episode on money. A financial guest gives what Carlson bills as a survival guide for a shaky era. Hard assets and hard truths are the theme throughout.

The guest explains why he trusts gold and Bitcoin more than a dollar backed by growing debt. He walks through what a bailout era would do to savings and prices. Carlson asks how a normal family should prepare now. Prepared and worried viewers get a fiscal warning with practical steps attached.
